game_concept: A card battler set in Snowy Hold – Snowdrift Barracks, barracks half buried in snow: the firewood keeper must handle winter bandits while practicing functions. Core idea – Keyword Switchboard: Call functions with keyword arguments to wire the right switches.
theme: Snowy Hold – Snowdrift Barracks: barracks half buried in snow
core_gameplay_loop: In Snowdrift Barracks, repeat each round: Call functions with keyword arguments to wire the right switches. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the wires value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Chain 10 consecutive correct decisions about wires to power up the firewood keeper and open the beacon fire.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 3 (intro tier): Keyword Switchboard
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Keyword Switchboard' (Week 6 slot 12), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Snowdrift Barracks'. tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how wires changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against winter bandits in Snowdrift Barracks.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 10.
